# Research exporter contract fixture

`ocsf-network-denial.json` is copied unchanged from
[NVIDIA/OpenShell-Research](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell-Research/blob/116fb82adad70a37c2669143e278e31c5e343895/projects/openshell-exporter/api/examples/ocsf-network-denial.json).

The fixture contains synthetic example data, not captured sandbox telemetry.
Receiver tests exercise envelope-v1 unwrapping, rendering and queue backpressure.
